chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:

Regarding a man who divorces his wife with two divorces while in good health, then divorces her with the third divorce while he is sick: she inherits him for as long as he remains in his illness, even if it lasts up to a year.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit her husband if she receives her third divorce while he is still alive but sick?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies that a third divorce pronounced during illness does not immediately sever the marital bond for inheritance purposes, allowing the wife to retain her status as an heir throughout the husband's illness, even if it lasts up to a year. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic view that the 'waiting period' (Iddah) and inheritance rights remain intact until death, distinguishing the legal effects of divorce during sickness from those during health. It underscores the principle that the physical state of the husband at the time of pronouncement influences the immediate legal consequences regarding his estate.
